recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-28492 unless a future work group decision changes the warning-level policy for Coding.display without Coding.code.
issue_request: FHIR-28492 was a Published FHIR-core datatypes clarification, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking whether Coding.code is required when Coding.display is populated and accepting warning-level invariant text advising against display without code.
initial_application: Commit 1afdc56774dad83e4bc0207bbfe0e78c599e3742 applied FHIR-28492 by adding the warning invariant text, FHIRPath expression code.exists().not() implies display.exists().not(), and equivalent XPath to source/datatypes/coding.xml; the parent revision did not contain the invariant phrase.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Coding as an active datatype routed through datatypes.html, and the Coding page renders datatype constraints via [%dt.constraints Coding%]. The originating Zulip discussion supported warning-level guidance because display-without-code is unsafe but edge cases exist. Later Published datatype issues FHIR-37603 and FHIR-38981 refined adjacent display-string and CodeableConcept.text narrative without removing or contradicting the FHIR-28492 invariant.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already has the requested warning invariant, and release5 generated history also contains the cod-1 warning generated from it.
